summary: Automations section: the module runs the automation engine when the extension core is composed (natives, consumer, schedules, maintenance and inbound poller, usage index for Integrations) and serves /automations (list with status, triggers, last run and attention) and the graph editor of @iota-uz/sdk/automation-editor over an RPC layer on engine.Service/Authoring/Operations; enabling goes through a human review of Code nodes with the code digest; layouts carry a revision (SaveLayoutAt, VERSION_CONFLICT); connector webhooks at /automations/hooks without a session; engine.Service gains Overviews, CountLive, SaveLayoutAt and Authoring.Validate; the editor gains EditorProps.remoteLayout.
